notes_for_editor: Brief coordinates (41.01091, -77.05997) match the MountainZone summit coordinates (41.0109138, -77.0599673), but the register lists none, so they locate the summit rather than a verified tower site. No source dates construction: the 1912-13 report only recommends a small tower, and the register's circa 1917 is the only tower-era date, so the story does not link the two. Do not confuse with the Buffalo Mountain in West Virginia (Mingo County, which has a 1961 tower on the Forest Lookouts page buffalo-mountain.html) or the Tennessee Pinnacle tower. Two searches and about four page reads found nothing on staffing, fires or current access.
